en: I wore my scarf ___ it was cold.
“Because” gives the reason: it was cold.
Ali likes apples, ___ he does not like pears.
“But” joins two ideas that are different.
It was raining, ___ we stayed inside.
“So” tells us what happened next because of the rain.
Would you like milk ___ hot chocolate?
“Or” gives a choice between two things.
I have a puppy ___ a kitten.
We go to the beach ___ the sun is out.
“When” tells us the time something happens.
The baby is tired, ___ she is going to sleep.
“So” shows what happens because she is tired.
Sam was sad ___ he lost his ball.
“Because” gives the reason Sam was sad.
The snowman melted ___ the sun came out.
“When” tells us the time the snowman melted.
Which word joins two ideas to give a reason?
I was hungry, ___ I ate a sandwich.
“So” tells us what happened because I was hungry.
Do you want to play inside ___ outside?
“Or” gives a choice between two things.
Mia can swim, ___ she cannot ride a bike.
“But” joins two ideas that are different.
The plant grew tall ___ we gave it water every day.
“Because” gives the reason the plant grew.
I put on my coat ___ my hat.
Dad smiles ___ he hears his favourite song.
“When” tells us the time Dad smiles.
The road was icy, ___ we walked slowly.
“So” shows what we did because the road was icy.
We can have pizza ___ pasta for tea.
“Or” gives a choice between two things.
The owl hoots ___ it gets dark.
“When” tells us the time the owl hoots.
Leo is small, ___ he is very strong.
“But” joins two ideas that are different.
I washed my hands ___ they were muddy.
“Because” gives the reason I washed my hands.
My kite flew high ___ the wind was strong.
“Because” gives the reason the kite flew high.
The lights went out, ___ we lit a candle.
“So” shows what we did because the lights went out.
“Or” gives a choice between two answers.
The birds sing ___ the sun comes up.
“When” tells us the time the birds sing.
I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
“But” joins two ideas that are different.
“Or” gives a choice, like “tea or juice?”
Which word joins two ideas that are different?
“But” joins two different ideas, like “small but strong”.
Which word tells us the time something happens?
“When” tells us the time, like “when the bell rings”.

example.q_en: I wore my scarf ___ it was cold.
example.why_en: “Because” gives the reason: it was cold.

en.title: Joining words
en.teach: Joining words link two ideas: and, but, because, so, or, when. I wore my coat because it was cold.
